name: Shinseiki Ijitte Princess Next 2 ~Kunoichi Hime Kasumi Sanjou!~
original_name: 新世紀いじってプリンセスNEXT2～くノ一姫カスミ参上！～
source:
Sin, the prince of the Supple Kingdom, and Janne are invited to a ceremony taken place in the Granju Kingdom. The ceremony finishes with no problems and they enjoy their time there for a while. However, a girl comes to see Janne. It is Kasumi, a Janne's old friend. Kasumi was also invited to the ceremony and she now looks for something. Kasumi asks Sin and Janne to help her and they accept it. According to Kasumi, what she looks for is somewhere around the town....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081030015115/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011017]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
萨普尔王国的王子辛与让娜受邀参加格兰朱王国举行的典礼。仪式顺利结束，两人也在那里悠闲地逗留了一段时间。然而，一名少女前来寻找让娜。她就是让娜的旧友霞。霞同样受邀参加典礼，如今正在寻找某样东西。她请求辛和让娜帮忙，两人答应了。据霞所说，她寻找的东西就在城镇附近……
